# Task 3.3 evidence-contract remediation

The focused contract test was first retained red for the required geometry
metadata assertion: [`3.3-contract-remediation-red.txt`](3.3-contract-remediation-red.txt).
It failed because the validator accepted a record lacking `outputs.geometry`, not
because the test or fixture was malformed.

After the contract artifacts were reconciled, the untouched test passed. The raw
green output is retained in
[`3.3-contract-remediation-green.txt`](3.3-contract-remediation-green.txt). It
exercises invalid fixtures, focused mutations for geometry, graph links, range
conversion, and non-scalar Unicode, canonical-order ties, and the 2,048-record
indexed linearity guard. Strict change validation passed in
[`3.3-contract-remediation-openspec.txt`](3.3-contract-remediation-openspec.txt).

Repository lint, format, typecheck, and test gates also passed; their raw outputs
are retained as [`lint`](3.3-contract-remediation-lint.txt),
[`format`](3.3-contract-remediation-format-check.txt),
[`typecheck`](3.3-contract-remediation-typecheck.txt), and
[`test`](3.3-contract-remediation-test.txt).
